required_shared_contracts.job_semantics: One admitted active worker. Reject new work after close starts. Cancellation/close signal the active worker before waiting on the serialization gate; successful return/close requires actual worker/native-call retirement. Isolation failure retains the actual cleanup owner/quarantine for later joined retry. FINISHED/result-ready and service-disconnect notifications alone do not prove process retirement. No destination/project DB/ambient URI or network access crosses the worker boundary.
required_shared_contracts.frame_binding_proposal: public data class DocumentFrameBinding(public val sourceAssetId: String, public val documentId: String, public val page: UInt, public val revision: ProjectInfo, public val attachmentEpoch: Long, public val viewportGeneration: Long)
required_shared_contracts.frame_binding_semantics: Coordinator must capture/match the complete immutable binding before native completion adoption, bitmap preparation and canvas adoption; compare source identity, project identity/full revision, page, attachment epoch and viewport generation. Never revive a cancelled generation merely because the viewport looks identical.
required_shared_contracts.frame_proposal: public data class DocumentDisplayFrame(public val binding: DocumentFrameBinding, public val tiles: List<DocumentDisplayTile>)
required_shared_contracts.pixel_contract: DocumentDisplayTile retains candidate origin/scale/width/height/rgba. Nonzero dimensions <=512 each, finite positive native scale, finite origins, exact width*height*4 bytes, straight RGBA8 sRGB. These are display derivatives, never original assets or an export source.
required_shared_contracts.privacy: Do not use generated data-class toString/Debug that emits passwords, request JSON, source/output bytes, private paths or provider URIs. Exceptions exposed to UI/diagnostics remain fixed typed failure kinds. Password is private transient memory only.
required_shared_contracts.installation: Coordinator owns installDocumentJobs/installedDocumentJobs and replacement lifecycle. Platform constructors return a fresh owned jobs instance; do not add a permanent global Android singleton that can retain a closed jobs object.

candidate_corrections_before_promotion: Android parent cancellation can race bind/connected wait, writer and output reading; the monitor must cover the entire admitted lifetime, not only post-send. Child FINISHED never substitutes for death proof. Quarantine must retain descriptors/output/native owner until proof.
Android raw blocking source-pipe writes and contentResolver stream calls can defeat joined cancellation; use bounded nonblocking descriptor paths/ProviderIo with retained per-operation ownership.
DocumentWire must reject truncated/oversized/malformed UTF8/unknown status or failure code/trailing bytes before adoption; never trust a child output length before bounded admission.

Desktop close must signal active cancellation before acquiring the run mutex, then join the native worker before destroying bindings or file pins. Attempt every owned close and retain failures instead of abandoning later grants after the first thrown close.
Original candidate Android publish does not delete partial owned SAF output; add truthful rollback failure behavior and revision checks.
Candidate tile caches key only object identity and lack authority/memory validation. Introduce the admitted source/revision/page/generation frame binding and account retained/temporary bitmap copies.
Password/source-bearing shared DTOs require safe diagnostic formatting; do not print candidate request/creation records.

Native artifact verification, Windows zero-capability worker and hard limits, Android isolated UID/native memory/time policy, and service/native resource packaging are coordinator prerequisites, not proven by these platform wrappers.
dedicated_test_plan: Reuse preserved source tests where within lane; root DocumentSwitchTest and Android controller instrumentation remain coordinator references.
Pure codec tests: exact status/magic and cap boundaries, short read/EOF, strict UTF8, unknown failures, trailing bytes on success and failure, exact payload length.

Job lifecycle tests with injected fake worker/binder/runtime: cancel during connection/write/native-call/result race; close cancels before waiting; no return/destroy/delete before joined retirement; uncertain death quarantines and blocks new work; retry cleanup uses the same owner.
Rendering tests: reject zero/overflow/invalid byte count/scale; known straight-RGBA-to-ARGB pixels, no authority/generation revival, bounded32 tiles, no bitmap recycling during live frames.
IO tests: source cap4MiB SVG/64MiB PDF, cancellation/stale checks, source/output hash mismatch and partial owned destination cleanup failure. Hardware/native tests stay separately pending.
